t: The Signature Tweezer Set: Three Tips, One Station
title: The Signature Tweezer Set: Three Tips, One Station
description: The Signature tweezer set is Justin Addam Higgins' precision trio — pointed, flat, and curved — docked in a bench station with tip covers attached, each slot labeled by job (jumpers, pads, reach). The set removes the 'which tweezer' question: the slot label names the job, you grab and work. Three tips, zero decisions.

demo.program:
print("Trio: pointed (jumpers) + flat (pads) + curved (reach).")
print("Station slots labeled BY JOB: grab the slot, do the job.")
print("Three tips, zero 'which tweezer' decisions.")

title: Signature Alignment Guarantee
description: Every Signature tweezer is tip-tested before it ships — the test card in the box shows the hair-test result for your pair. Tips are ground as a matched set, not two separate pieces, so alignment survives drops that kill cheap tweezers. The guarantee is printed: perfect meeting tips, or the pair is replaced.

demo.program:
print("Tip-tested pre-ship: YOUR pair's hair-test card in the box.")
print("Tips ground as matched set: alignment survives drops.")
print("Printed guarantee: perfect meeting or replaced.")

title: Signature Grip Zones
description: The Signature handles have grip zones — textured where fingers go, smooth where they do not — teaching the pen grip by feel. The tension is calibrated light: the tweezer holds a jumper without finger effort. Ergonomics that teach technique: the tool trains the hand holding it.

demo.program:
print("Textured finger zones: pen grip taught by feel.")
print("Calibrated light tension: holds jumper without effort.")
print("Tool trains the hand: ergonomics as instruction.")

title: Signature ESD Verification Mark
description: Each Signature tweezer carries a lot-coded ESD verification mark — the dissipative spec it tested to, printed on the handle. No mystery coating: the number is there. The mark is re-verifiable with a resistivity meter, and the spec card explains the test. Trust, but printed.

demo.program:
print("Lot-coded mark: tested dissipative spec, printed on handle.")
print("Re-verifiable with meter; spec card explains the test.")
print("No mystery coating: the number is ON the tool.")

title: Signature vs Standard Tweezers
description: Standard: one mystery-coated tweezer, maybe aligned, technique not included. Signature: three job-labeled tips, tested alignment with card, grip zones teaching hold, verified ESD spec printed, station docking. Same picking-up physics — the Signature adds certainty at every step where standard tweezers quietly fail.

title: Signature Pad Placement Jig
description: For M.2 pads, the Signature jig is a placement frame: lay the pad in the frame, lower onto the drive — perfect position, no fingerprints, no repositioning. The frame fits standard M.2 lengths. Thermal interfaces go on exactly right the first time, which matters because repositioned pads perform worse.

demo.program:
print("Placement frame: pad in frame, lower onto drive. Perfect, first time.")
print("Fits standard M.2 lengths. No fingerprints, no repositioning.")
print("Repositioned pads perform worse: first-time-right matters.")

title: Signature Reverse-Action Placement Tweezer
description: The Signature reverse-action tweezer grips at rest — squeeze to open, release to hold — for placing rows of identical parts (standoffs' washers, multiple jumpers) without hand fatigue. The rest-grip is calibrated gentle: holds firmly, never crushes. Batch placement stops being a hand workout.

demo.program:
print("Reverse-action: grips at REST, squeeze to open. Batch placement, no fatigue.")
print("Calibrated gentle: firm hold, never crush.")
print("Rows of identical parts: the fatigue-free tool.")

title: Signature Field Tweezer
description: The field tweezer is the pointed Signature pair in a locking sheath — protected tips in the go-bag, instant deployment on site. Field rule: jumpers and pads get tweezers even on site; fingers never touch thermal interfaces. The sheath clips to the tool roll; the discipline travels.

print("Field rule: thermal interfaces NEVER get fingers, even on site.")
print("Sheath clips to tool roll: discipline travels.")

title: Signature Training: The Jumper Drill
description: New builders drill twenty jumper placements on a practice header — place, remove, replace — timed, with the magnifier. Under five minutes with zero bent pins passes. The drill builds the light touch and straight motion that real headers demand. Bent pins on practice, never on boards.

demo.program:
print("Drill: 20 jumper place/remove on practice header, magnified, timed.")
print("Pass: <5 min, zero bent pins.")
print("Light touch + straight motion: learned on practice, used on boards.")

title: Signature Coating Inspection Standard
description: The Signature standard: inspect handle coating quarterly under the magnifier — wear spots get marked, and coating worn through over large areas retires the tweezer to non-ESD duty (labeled, so it never touches boards again). The inspection is on the station card. Protection is verified, not assumed.

demo.program:
print("Quarterly: magnifier-inspect handle coating.")
print("Large-area wear: retire to NON-ESD duty, LABELED (never boards again).")
print("On station card: protection verified, not assumed.")

title: Signature Parts-Presentation Tray
description: The Signature presentation tray is a small dissipative dish with compartments for the parts being placed — jumpers in one, screws in another — so the tweezer never hunts across the bench. The tray sits in the magnifier's work zone. Parts presented, tool ready, work magnified: the complete small-parts workstation.

print("Dissipative compartment dish: parts presented in the work zone.")
print("Tweezer never hunts the bench. Under the magnifier.")
print("Parts + tool + magnification: the complete small-parts station.")
